step: 4 | missing: whether same-day delivery is offered

cases.text:
That information isn't covered in our current policy documentation, so I'm not able to give you a definitive answer on same-day delivery.

What I *can* tell you is that our fastest available shipping option, per **kb/02-shipping-policy.md**, is **Overnight** delivery (next business day, when ordered by 1 PM local time) for $24.95.

If you'd like to confirm whether same-day delivery is available in your area or for your order, feel free to reach out to our support team directly:

- **Chat:** Available on our website during business hours
- **Phone:** 1-800-555-0199
- **Email:** support@trailforge.example
